violence.rationale: Subtitles include threats of murder and shooting, explicit gun-related commands and outcomes (rounds fired, many vehicles destroyed), bombs and references to killing. These are realistic violent threats and actions but not graphic or gory, so 'moderate'.
evidence: They tried to murder me, before I was born.
Move or I'll do sware... or I will shoot you!

sex.rationale: Dialogue contains expressions of love/romance and references to 'sexy' (Victoria's Secret) but no sexual acts, explicit sexual talk or nudity in the subtitles — fits 'mild'.

language.rationale: Subtitles contain multiple strong profanities and insults, including the f-word and repeated insults (e.g. 'Fuck you!', 'Son of bitch!', 'asshole'), which meets the 'strong' level.
evidence: This is my company car, asshole!

substances.rationale: Dialogue includes incidental alcohol references ('Hide a beer') and name-calling such as 'Junkies!' indicating drug-related language, but no depiction of heavy drinking, addiction or dealing — 'mild'.
